Hungry at Midnight in Charlotte?

It is Friday night. The game is over, the shift just ended, and every kitchen in town is closed. So where do you get real smoked ribs at 1 in the morning?

Here Is the Part Most People Miss

This Truck Is Just Getting Started When Everyone Else Closes

Charlotte Ribman runs a second late night shift starting at 11 PM, Friday and Saturday, and goes straight through to 3 AM on Sunday. Same smoker, same hibachi flat top, in the middle of the night.

The Truck Behind the Smoke

A Brookshire Blvd Weekend Tradition

EST. 2014

Charlotte, North Carolina

For over a decade, Charlotte Ribman has set up at the Mobil station on Brookshire Blvd and done one thing, three days a week: smoked meat and hibachi, served late. No dining room, no fuss. Just a truck, a smoker, and a line of people who know where to go when the rest of the city has gone home.

Follow the truck on Instagram at @charlotte.ribman for weekend menus and late night hours.
